changelog: Risk ladder now live in the backtest engine: when a session's ladder is active (use_flat_risk=0), every order sizes from the tier matching START-OF-DAY equity (closed equity at the first bar of the current UTC replay day, floating P&L excluded) -- never the current instant's equity, so a same-day loss can't flip the tier out from under a trade until the NEXT replay day starts. A limit order's own tier is fixed at placement (re-derived from closed-trade history as of its own placed_at_bar_time, not fill time), not recomputed when it eventually fills.

The ticket's risk field now prefills from the ladder tier (previously always the flat risk_pct, with a client-side current-equity approximation used only for the off-ladder note); a new line under Risk shows 'Tier 0.5% - start-of-day equity $9,340 (93.4%)' while the ladder is active. Off-ladder trades are never blocked -- only shown via the existing amber note and recorded on the trade row. Header strip gains a 'Tier {x}%' badge next to Equity/Target/Loss, shown only when the ladder is active.

Every fill (market or limit) now records planned_risk_pct (the ladder tier, or flat risk_pct when the ladder is off), actual_risk_pct, balance_at_day_start and risk_deviation_pct on the trades row -- all four already-existing v3.15/v3.16 columns, no schema change. A flat-risk session (including session 6) behaves exactly as before.

Two updater.php fixes (explicit, briefed exception to the usual do-not-touch rule): the backup list was sorting by folder NAME as a string (so 'backup_v3.9.x' sorted above the newer 'backup_v3.22.x'), now sorted by real modification time; and retention now keeps only the newest 20 backup_v* folders after each successful update (there were ~106 on live with no cap before this), with a realpath() containment check and a hard exemption for the backup that same update run just created.
release_notes: No schema change -- every trades column this release writes already existed since v3.15.0/v3.16.0 (challenge-ladder Phase 1/2); db_migrations is empty. New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v32210.mjs (32 assertions) against two fresh stateful mock sessions (24, 25, both an active ladder) plus existing flat session 20 -- stubs/api.php gained a start-of-day-equity/tier mirror of the real server logic and real risk-based position sizing (scoped to the ladder scenario only; every other mock session keeps its flat 0.5 lot estimate unchanged) so the driver could engineer a specific, provable equity drop from the mock's own fixed candle sequence. Covers: tier 1.0% at 100% equity with the ticket prefilling 1; a same-day loss into the 92.5-95% band with the tier provably unchanged until the next replay day, then becoming 0.5%; a deeper loss (session 25) dropping the next day below 92.5% to tier 0.25%; typing 1% while the tier is 0.5% -- the amber note's exact text and the trade row landing at planned_risk_pct 0.5 / actual_risk_pct 1 / risk_deviation_pct 100, never blocked; and the flat session showing no tier anywhere. The engine self-test (104 assertions including 6 new ladder-tier boundary cases) also runs standalone inside the driver. The updater.php fixes are separately verified by a new standalone CLI test, tools/test-updater-backups.php, against ~30 fake backup_v* folders with explicit controlled mtimes (not real-time-dependent) -- confirms the mtime sort survives a deliberately name-vs-mtime-mismatched pair, retention keeps exactly the newest 20 of 30, and the just-created backup survives even when its own mtime is deliberately the oldest of the batch. drive.mjs, drive-v3223.mjs, drive-v3225.mjs, drive-v3226.mjs, drive-v3227.mjs, drive-v3228.mjs and drive-v3229.mjs all pass unmodified. php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. Next up: v3.23.0 (gate checklist).
